storage.encoding: resilient bencoded Map, not Qt header bytes
storage.resolution: An existing exact Table.<id> map wins even if empty; only absence/null permits cloned TableDefault.<baseID>. BaseID strips after LAST ::. Wrong map type is not source-valid absence.
storage.subtable_ids: Library.EnableSepColConfig enables <base>::Tag_<UID> for manual/state tags, or <base>::TagGroup_<Base32 UTF8 group>. They are distinct from base, .big and .small tables.
storage.column_key: Column.<stable source column ID>; never label, translation or Qt logical/visual index
storage.opaque_retention: Whole immutable Document and original bytes retain unknown tables/plugin columns, malformed fields, userData, list tails and non-UTF8 bytes; no rewriting.
storage.parser_compatibility_limit: Existing native Document parser rejects duplicate dictionary keys (duplicate_key); repeated list items/sort IDs and distinct unknown keys are retained. Do not claim preservation of an originally duplicate dictionary that cannot be admitted by the frozen parser.

ordering.source: Comparator maps negative positions to 0xFFFF+position, subtracts int positions; ties prefer runtime default ID list then column name, except POSITION_LAST ties. ensureIntegrity reindexes all except -1 and hides -1. Zero admitted positions can trigger Reset/write.
ordering.dependency: Runtime registered plugin columns/default list and hooks affect ordering; raw unknown columns do not authorize fake registry recreation.
ordering.proposed_admission: Use accepted unique nonnegative positions for relative order of corresponding native columns; compact gaps and append unmatched native columns in construction order. Negative/duplicate/extreme wrapped positions get diagnostics/fallback. Native bounded admission is not full Java normalization.

sort.current: Ordered SortColumns list, IDs from UTF8 MapUtils.getString (wrong member yields null). Empty list triggers painted default sort (# for MyTorrentsView).
sort.legacy_table: If no valid SortColumns list, SortColumn accepts String or byte[] decoded with JVM default charset.
sort.legacy_global: Then <tableID>.sortColumn in biglybt.config; getter removes old .sortColumn AND .sortAsc. It does not read .sortAsc here. Never remove either in read-only reader.
sort.direction: Column list[4] carries per-column direction. config.style.table.defaultSortOrder also affects constructor/user-sort changes. Negative direction is not known ascending.
sort.multiple: Original supports multiple ordered IDs and per-column directions. Unknown ID lookup can substitute registry tableColumns[0], which has no safe stable native identity.
sort.comparison: Table.sort.intuitive and source-specific typed comparators differ from Qt; imported settings alone prove no row-sort parity.
sort.native_policy_proposed: Preserve full sort list; apply only known single ID with known direction. Unsupported/multiple/unknown primary retains existing native sort plus diagnostic; do not promote later known ID.

defaults_migrations.runtime_defaults: TableColumnCreator sets incomplete/complete ID order including optional plugin IDs. Missing Column.* or none visible among registered columns invokes visibility defaults and # ascending.
defaults_migrations.user_defaults: Absent exact table can use cloned TableDefault.<base>; Reset uses user defaults when present. Empty exact map is not absent.
defaults_migrations.legacy_fields: Missing/wrong list position/width/autoTooltip read Table.<tableID>.<columnID>.position/.width/.auto_tooltip from biglybt.config. saveSettings removes all3 if old width exists.
defaults_migrations.version: last.reset migration is implemented but mapResetTable_Version has NO active entries and RERESET=false in pinned commit. Preserve metadata; invent no migration threshold.
defaults_migrations.native_gap: ClassicColumns Reset currently means construction snapshot, not Java/user default. Name header Stretch overrides saved fixed width unless later GUI application chooses Interactive.
defaults_migrations.default_expression_note: Expressions ending .COLUMN_ID name exact source constants, not literal serialized IDs; the complete creator bodies are pinned. Native admission never recreates absent plugin registrations from these arrays.

Result owns shared_ptr<const Document>, table/default provenance, raw IDs/fields, optional signed-low32 facts and bounded issues; reject edited raw/projection mismatch.
first_stage_design.adapter: Separate storage::readClassicColumnLayoutsView(const ProfileLease&,stop_token) reads fixed tables.config through ConfigFile::load(core::Limits{}). Missing distinct loaded/RecoverySource; verify 3 exact candidates absent after inherited Missing ambiguity. No save, reacquire, original recovery or arbitrary paths.
first_stage_design.legacy_scope: First stage reports legacy-global fallback-needed; does not implicitly read large biglybt.config. A later caller-supplied bounded global Document can resolve keys with independent provenance; source declared filename and aliases stay exact.
first_stage_design.bounds: Only lower limits. Checked aggregate/count budgets before copying fields. Opaque data charged once to document, no duplicated plugin subtrees. Invalid/limit errors distinct; no silent truncation.
first_stage_design.readLibrarySource_impact: Do not add unconditional table I/O/failures to shared host/plugin library reader. New optional read once/open or explicit layout reload on existing Host worker and lease; no per-torrent reads or every-refresh reload.
first_stage_design.ownership: Immutable owned packet crosses GUI boundary; borrowed views remain backed. Separate files are not transactional. Existing Target/revision/close guards remain; no path chasing/profile reacquire/payload reads.
first_stage_design.application_later: Whitelisted stable IDs only, preserve logical0..12/model/selection. Validate before GUI mutation; use per-profile/request and local-layout generations so late results cannot overwrite user edits. Detached MyTorrents retains its table state.
first_stage_design.write_scope: No ID/config writes now. Full raw-preserving writer/conflict protocol and original multisort/default/plugin semantics remain open.
